matching: longest spelling first; a match must not sit inside a longer run of Hangul syllables
note: Only these registered spellings are searched for in raw_text. General Hangul tokenisation is deliberately not performed: Korean words carry no reliable boundaries, so an open tokeniser would flood the candidate list. Every target already exists in the final_techs vocabulary; this file adds ways to write a name, never a new standard name.
boundary_rule: A spelling only counts when the characters immediately before and after it are not Hangul syllables. Without this rule 뷰 matched 코드 리뷰 (3,257 postings instead of 27), 루비 matched 그루비, 장고 matched 냉장고, 지라 matched 할지라도, 러스트 matched 트러스트 and 일러스트, and 깃 matched 깃허브.
longest_match_rule: Spellings are tried from longest to shortest and a matched span is consumed, so 자바스크립트 is never reported as 자바 and 리액트 네이티브 is never reported as 리액트.

excluded_on_purpose.뷰: the ordinary Korean word for a view; 27 boundary-safe hits are mostly 뷰 설계 and 뷰 개발, not Vue.js
excluded_on_purpose.노드: the ordinary word for a node; 풀노드 and 노드 서버 are blockchain and infrastructure terms, not Node.js
excluded_on_purpose.비트: bit, and the exchange name 업비트; Vite is more often written in Latin letters
excluded_on_purpose.깃: 0 boundary-safe hits: every occurrence belongs to 깃허브 or 깃랩, and 깃 alone is an ordinary word
excluded_on_purpose.펄: 0 boundary-safe hits: occurrences belong to names such as 펄크루트 and 펄사게이밍
excluded_on_purpose.러스트: 0 boundary-safe hits: occurrences belong to 트러스트 and 일러스트
excluded_on_purpose.루비: 0 boundary-safe hits: occurrences belong to 그루비, which is Groovy and not Ruby
excluded_on_purpose.다트: occurrences belong to company names such as 피닉스다트
excluded_on_purpose.몽고: the country name 몽고 is as common as the database abbreviation
excluded_on_purpose.엘라스틱: a fragment that could be Elasticsearch or an unrelated word; 엘라스틱서치 is registered instead
excluded_on_purpose.컨플루언스: Confluence is not part of the final_techs vocabulary, so registering it would mean inventing a standard name
excluded_on_purpose.고랭: no occurrence in the eligible postings, so there is no evidence to register it
